about.heading: One person, the whole pipeline.
about.body: I'm James — a solo developer working freelance on AI automation and integration, currently building toward a role in AI project management. I like taking a system from idea to something that runs unattended: the trigger, the generation, the human checkpoint, and the dashboard that tells you whether it's working. Everything below was scoped, built, and shipped by me.
